notes: §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR10: "The NO REWIND and REVERSED phrases will be ignored if they do not apply to the storage medium on which the file resides." The NO REWIND half conforms: every sequential file is on a non-reel/unit medium, FileRegistry.NoRewindPhraseEffect lets the OPEN run as a plain open and overlays I-O status 07 on a successful one (§1985:VII.1.3.5: "for an OPEN statement with the NO REWIND phrase, the referenced file is on a non-reel/unit medium"); probed at --std 85, OPEN INPUT and OPEN OUTPUT WITH NO REWIND position at the beginning, create or empty the file, and report 07 (a failed open keeps 35; an absent OPTIONAL input file reports 07 where the plain open reports 05). REVERSED is implemented, not ignored, for record sequential files (the 1985 arm: CheckOpenTapePhrase admits it, COBOL0902 from 2002; ReversedPhraseEffect and PositionReversed set the position past the last record and the backward direction), which is right where the medium can deliver records in reversed order (§1985:p.XVII-94 item 14; §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR12); probed on a regular file, fixed and RECORD VARYING, the records come last to first and then at end. The part that breaks the rule: on a medium that cannot be positioned the phrase is still honoured instead of ignored. PositionReversed sets the direction whatever the medium, and ReadRecord's backward arm answers a stream that SeekToOrdinal cannot position with the permanent error 30 (the member's own remarks say so). Observed with the pinned build on Linux against a FIFO: the plain OPEN INPUT and OPEN INPUT WITH NO REWIND read REC1 REC2 REC3 (status 00 and 07), and OPEN INPUT REVERSED returns 00 and then 30 on every READ with no record delivered. docs/CONFORMANCE.md states nothing about REVERSED or the media it applies to. The witness is the NO REWIND half on a disk file (OPEN OUTPUT and OPEN INPUT WITH NO REWIND, first record read back).

next.reason: 1985 GR10: 'The NO REWIND and REVERSED phrases will be ignored if they do not apply to the storage medium'. 2023 keeps the NO REWIND half: §2023:14.9.27.4 GR11 'The NO REWIND phrase will be ignored if it does not apply to the storage medium' (OPEN successful, status '07', as §2023:9.1.13.2 GR6 and 1985 status 07 both say). REVERSED (obsolete in 1985 4.3.1) is absent from the 2023 OPEN format §2023:14.9.27.2 and every 2023 OPEN rule, so the REVERSED case of this rule has no 2023 counterpart: a case removed.
